name: houserules
title_zh: 给编码 Agent 立规矩、配技能
tagline_zh: 不用云服务、不装依赖，纯 Python 就能让 Agent 按你的项目规矩干活，每次交付前自动验证。
tagline_en: No cloud, no deps—pure Python rules, skills & verification for your coding agent. Like hiring a QA for every.
desc_en: Give your coding agent project rules, optional skills and a repeatable way to verify work. Local, stdlib-only Python.
why_zh: 把项目规矩、可选技能和验收脚本打包成 Agent 能读的本地文件，stdlib 就能跑，规矩不靠嘴说。
why_en: Turns project rules, optional skills & acceptance checks into local, stdlib-only Python files—enforced by code, not by chat.
limit_zh: 只约束支持读取 houserules 目录的 Agent（如 Claude Code）。
limit_en: Only works with agents that read a houserules/ dir (e.g., Claude Code). No IDE/CI hooks; you write your own verification scripts.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Local rules, skills & self-check for coding agents
